notice: UNVERIFIED CONCEPT ART — NOT FOR PATIENT USE
register: Contemporary medical illustration: accurate adult anatomy, soft even lighting, muted skin tones, clean off-white background, no text of any kind. One consistent adult across every asset. Nothing clinical that the overlays draw: no tape, no labels, no arrows, no devices before activation.
grounding: Prompts follow evals/safety-cards/medical-reference-packet.md: the incision runs behind the ear in the postauricular crease; the immediate dressing is a full head wrap covering the operated ear; fluid is a localized subcutaneous bulge behind the ear; the external system is a behind-the-ear processor with a round transmitter coil held on the scalp above and behind the ear. Reference images inform these sentences and are never uploaded.

claim.anatomy: The area behind an adult's right ear, seen from behind and slightly to the side, hair kept away from the ear.
claim.state: A healed, thin, pale incision line in the crease where the back of the ear meets the head, seen from behind; hair clipped short behind the ear. No dressing, no tape, no redness, no swelling, no device.
forbidden: incision on the cheek, jaw, neck, or in front of the ear

assets.prompt: Flat medical illustration, textbook figure style, not a photograph and not a 3D render. An adult person's head seen from directly behind and slightly to the right, so the back of the right ear and the bare skin in the crease behind it fill the frame; the face is not visible at all. The hair above and behind the ear is clipped very short, as after ear surgery, so the skin behind the ear is completely exposed. A single thin, pale, fully healed surgical incision line runs in the crease where the back of the ear meets the head, curving from just above the top of the ear down toward the earlobe, staying behind the ear the whole way. Skin otherwise normal: no tape, no dressing, no bandage, no redness, no swelling, no device, no blood. Soft even lighting, muted natural skin tones, clean off-white background, accurate anatomy. No text, no labels, no captions, no arrows, no logos, no watermark.
observers_must_recover: the back or side of a person's head with the area behind the ear in view
a thin healed line or scar behind the ear, not on the face or neck

assets.prompt: Edit this medical illustration so the person wears a cochlear implant external system on the right ear. Draw exactly two parts and one cord.
